items.title: 1Password adds pop-pup warnings for suspected phishing sites
items.description: The 1Password digital vault and password manager has added built-in protection against phishing URLs to help users identify malicious pages and prevent them from sharing account credentials with threat actors. [...]

items.title: Microsoft investigates Windows 11 boot failures after January updates
items.description: Microsoft is investigating reports that some Windows 11 devices are failing to boot with "UNMOUNTABLE_BOOT_VOLUME" errors after installing the January 2026 Patch Tuesday security updates. [...]
